acceptance_criteria.criterion: App.tsx uses the useClassRange hook and passes results to ResultsPanel
Class-range calculation fires when sliders change, using the currently selected ship type
shipId is included in the physics calculation request to enable real per-ship data lookup
Both single-ship and class-range calculations run independently without race conditions
Class-range uses 500ms debounce; single-ship remains at 300ms
ClassRangePanel appears in the right panel below existing single-ship results and updates reactively
Total user feedback (debounce + API + render) is <600ms
All modified files compile under TypeScript strict mode
